One label, two numbers 5.7 KB apart, and a control plane reading the green one can hand a seat 22 per cent more context than it just checked. The envelope forbids moving either cap - that is a decision row, not a lane - and asks instead that the prefix be labelled as the prefix and that the total a seat actually receives be reported and AGREE with what packet.mjs prints, the agreement being the property rather than the formatting. It also names the empty case as its own property, because a landing deletes the envelope so the path with nothing to measure is the one that runs most often, and a silent pass there is indistinguishable from a check that never ran. F50 takes what F47's correction could not: its fixture 7 spawns the shipped file and proves the probe is wired into the CLI, but it needs a repository to resolve a sha and SKIPS without one, which is exactly how gate step 15 runs it. It also left one structural note the control plane is keeping rather than waving through: the combined band cannot fail on its OWN, because prefix and envelope are each capped and their caps add to the sum cap, so any lane over the sum has a part already over. What T82 buys is VISIBILITY at issue, not a new way to fail, and the trap row says so in those words rather than implying a check that is not there.
